report.scope: Same source/compiler with State range fusion explicitly disabled/enabled. Worker bytes count retained f/w/e/fs and numbered loop/owned-entry/argument helpers, including GCC clones and inlined runtime work; shared runtime functions are excluded. All .text bytes are also reported. Stack is the largest compiler-reported component in the translation unit, not a total stack bound. Ordinary startup and cleanup remain; a volatile entry pointer prevents constant folding. No elapsed-time or C/Rust claim.
